# The Notebook {.sdaia-dark background-gradient="linear-gradient(135deg, #1C355E, #00C9A7)"}

Facts the agent keeps about you

## Stop Re-Introducing Yourself {auto-animate=true}

::: {data-id="notebook" style="background: #f7f9fc; padding: 1.2em; border-radius: 12px; border-left: 4px solid #00C9A7;"}
A **notebook** where the office jots down lasting facts about you — your role, your
preferences, your recurring projects — and flips back to it on future visits.
:::

. . .

::: {style="text-align: center; margin-top: 0.5em;"}
**Persistent facts**, stored **across sessions** and re-sent when relevant — so you don't
restate them each time.
:::

## The Difference It Makes {auto-animate=true}

::: {style="background: #1C355E; color: #ffffff; padding: 1.5em; border-radius: 12px; text-align: center; font-size: 1.15em;"}
The agent stops feeling like a **stranger every morning**.
:::

. . .

::: {style="text-align: center; margin-top: 0.5em;"}
The difference between a **temp** and an assistant who's worked with you **for a year**.
:::

# Memory vs. `CLAUDE.md` {.sdaia-dark background-gradient="linear-gradient(135deg, #1C355E, #9B8EC0)"}

Two notebooks, two jobs

## Rules You Set vs. Facts It Keeps {auto-animate=true}

:::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="50%"}
::: {.fragment .fade-in}
::: {style="background: #f7f9fc; padding: 1.2em; border-radius: 12px; border-left: 4px solid #1C355E;"}
**`CLAUDE.md`** — the wall note

Rules **you set** on purpose.

Per **Project**.
:::
:::
:::
::: {.column width="50%"}
::: {.fragment .fade-in}
::: {style="background: #f7f9fc; padding: 1.2em; border-radius: 12px; border-left: 4px solid #00C9A7;"}
**Memory** — the notebook

Facts the agent **accumulates** about you.

**Across** Projects.
:::
:::
:::
::::

. . .

::: {.callout-note}
## Rule of thumb
A standing **rule for one project** → `CLAUDE.md`. A fact about **you** that's true
everywhere → Memory.
:::

# Your Default Persona {.sdaia-dark background-gradient="linear-gradient(135deg, #1C355E, #00C9A7)"}

Sound like you, everywhere

## Set It Once {auto-animate=true}

Seed Memory with your defaults so the agent always sounds like **you**, not a robot —
across **every** Project:

::: {.incremental}
- **Role** — who you are and what you do
- **Tone** — how you write (concise, warm, direct…)
- **Format** — your go-to structure (BLUF, bullets, headers)
:::

. . .

::: {.callout-tip}
## The payoff
A new Project still starts in your voice — no setup, no reminding.
:::

# Build: Seed the Notebook {.sdaia-dark background-gradient="linear-gradient(135deg, #1C355E, #9B8EC0)"}

Then prove it carries over

## Hands-On {auto-animate=true}

::: {.callout-tip}
## Steps
1. Seed Memory with your **working style** + a few **standing facts**.
2. **Start a fresh session.**
3. Ask for something — confirm it **carries your style over** with zero reminders.
:::

. . .

::: {style="text-align: center; font-weight: bold; margin-top: 0.5em;"}
That carry-over **is** the office re-sending the right pages (the two layers).
:::

# Safety Beat {.sdaia-dark background-gradient="linear-gradient(135deg, #FF7A5C, #1C355E)"}

Memory is context too

## Keep the Notebook Clean {auto-animate=true}

::: {style="background: #1C355E; color: #ffffff; padding: 1.5em; border-radius: 12px; text-align: center; font-size: 1.15em;"}
Memory gets **re-sent** to the brain. So the **Newspaper Test** applies here too.
:::

. . .

::: {.callout-warning}
## Nothing in the notebook…
…that you wouldn't want re-sent. Keep it **sanitized** — no secrets, no raw PII.
:::

## Key Takeaways {.sdaia-dark background-color="#1C355E"}

::: {.incremental}
1. **Memory = the notebook** — persistent facts about you, across sessions
2. **`CLAUDE.md` vs Memory** — rules you set (per project) vs facts it keeps (everywhere)
3. **Default persona** — set Role, Tone, Format once; sound like you everywhere
4. **It's still context** — keep Memory sanitized; nothing you wouldn't want re-sent
5. **One-off details** — belong in the message, not the notebook
:::
